save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer history and extra state to a file
load_model_state: load a model's state dict from a checkpoint file and restore model parameters
load_ensemble_for_inference: load an ensemble of models from checkpoint files for inference with optional arg overrides
convert_state_dict_type: recursively convert all tensors in a state dict to a specified tensor type
make_positions: replace non-padding symbols in a tensor with their position numbers for sequence modeling
